propositions: add_comment returns raw ACLI batch mutation envelope (results/totalCount/successCount) instead of normalized comment resource, causing mismatch between declared type dict[str,Any] and consumer expectation
caller _record_comment_id reads result.get("id") expecting comment id but receives WORK ITEM key from batch envelope results[].id, leading to silent failures and comment re-posting
sibling functions (get_comments, get_issue, create_issue) normalize at transport boundary while add_comment skips this idiom, creating inconsistent error handling patterns

add_comment must parse stdout through _parse_comment_created helper to normalize: resource-shaped dict passes through, batch envelope normalizes to {"id": None, "acli_envelope": ...}, unrecognized shapes raise RuntimeError
other acli --json mutation wrappers (acli.update_issue workitem edit) exhibit same raw passthrough pattern but lack consumer-reachable hazard today
